Seccomp filter for write and fsync on stdout and logfile_fd.

# Purpose
This generated header defines a seccomp BPF filter for the `fd_sign_tile` component and limits the system calls that the process can use at runtime. It checks the target CPU architecture with `ARCH_NR`, then allows only `SYS_write` and `SYS_fsync` when they use approved file descriptors, including `2` for standard error and `logfile_fd` for the log file. All other system calls, or calls from a different architecture, end with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`, which stops the process. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_sign_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_sign_tile>) function builds the filter program in a `struct sock_filter` array, and the header guard prevents multiple inclusion.
